# Sara Ruddick

*1935 – 2011 · American · [Feminist philosophy](../movements/feminist-philosophy.md)*

American philosopher and a figure of care ethics: in *Maternal Thinking* (1989), she draws from the practice of caring a distinctive form of thought, including "attentive love", taken from Simone Weil and Iris Murdoch.
